scope: Agent visual/scenario review of exact native captures; not a human study or complete accessibility qualification. Public delivery closes separately.
findings: Original app icons, unique groups and numeric window badges retain readable app identity.
Numbered chooser rows distinguish actual folder/document and unsaved state; light/dark controls remain legible.
Compact thirteen-hidden-app overflow reaches a second bounded page; physical 3840x2160/200% fits all eight pins without a spurious More apps control.
Taskbar names abbreviate within their bounded buttons; full app/window identities remain available through Start and chooser menus.

carry_forward.observation: Retain shared-menu footer fitting, transfer/modal arbitration and Start query/notice feedback. New empty Editor currently says Saved document before its first save; distinguish new/unsaved/saved using real persistence state and test it.
Retain cursor/hit isolation and explicit scale versus compact startup reconciliation.
